name: SH2 domain containing 1A

function.text: SH2D1A encodes SH2 domain-containing protein 1A. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in cell-cell signaling and cellular defense response.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked lymphoproliferative disease due to SH2D1A deficiency (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
